leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the prepared surface and support felt a little repetitive after making them, even though it showed where each belonged.

surprise.text: Closing the surface did not mean healing was finished; the deeper tissue still needed support and a blood supply.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. Clearing the clot had a clear purpose once the result showed it was temporary.
